name: Santa Tracker
author: Jimson Circle of Lights
description: Shows Santa's live position on a Pixel Overlay Model: a world map with Santa, his trail and your town, with a Christmas Eve countdown or an info panel (city, distance, gifts delivered), or a scrolling message. Settings page with a live preview, plus FPP Commands to start, stop and preview it. While in use it downloads Google's public Santa Tracker route (firebasestorage.googleapis.com) and, once, public-domain world map data (coastlines, lakes, borders) (raw.githubusercontent.com, with cdn.jsdelivr.net and d2ad6b4ur7yvpq.cloudfront.net as fallbacks). Nothing about you or your show is sent. Map frames are written to FPP's images folder as santa_map_*.png and cleaned up automatically.

privacy.summary: Downloads Google's public Santa route and free world map data so it can draw Santa on your matrix. Sends nothing about you or your show.

sends.what: A plain download request for Google's public Santa Tracker route file. No settings or show data.
sends.why: To know where Santa is on Christmas Eve.

sends.what: Plain download requests for Natural Earth map files (coastlines, lakes, borders). No settings or show data.
sends.why: To draw the map. Downloaded once and saved.

privacy.other: The plugin author keeps no data. The route file is published by Google (privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy); the world outline is public-domain Natural Earth data.
